newsitem.title: UK: Gehe says stake in Lloyds Chem 78.37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gehe says stake in Lloyds Chem 78.37 pct.

text.p: German drug wholesaler and manufacturer Gehe AG said on Monday that its stake in British retail chain Lloyds Chemists Plc stood at 78.37 percent.
Gehe said it had agreed to purchase 7.24 million shares, representing 57.46 percent or Lloyds' capital, at 525 pence a share through its broker Cazenove & Co on Monday.
Gehe also said it had agreed to purchase 3,406,955 preference shares at 338.7 pence representing 51.24 percent of Lloyds Chemists' preference share capital.
Now it has interest in a total 57.06 percent of Lloyds Chemist's preference share capital.
Gehe, based in Stuttgart, ended a year-long fight to gain control of Lloyds on Monday after it edged out its rival Unichem Plc.
Gehe raised its cash bid for Lloyds on Friday to 525 pence per share from 500 pence, valuing Lloyds at 684 million stg and away from Unichem's reach.
